title: Favourite trumpeters: Louis Armstrong and Chris Kelly
summary: Howard names Armstrong as his man and Chris Kelly, with his muted playing, next.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: In regard to the old time trombone, who was your favorite? Of course, it's hard to pick one person. Who were the, of all the fellows you've ever heard in your life on trumpet, who did you like best? Probably, I know you talked about doing Armstrong, you just mentioned. Oh yeah. Would he be your favorite or are there other fellows?
No, no. Nobody like Lloyd after me. That's my man. That's my man.
And most people would say that I think too.
I've always loved that he's playing. See, I still do.
Next to him of the other old timers, who would you pick? Well, Chris.
I loved him with that sweet playing with that mute. You see, that was great.
